decision_rules: Preservation gate is evaluated before literary preference.
A challenger must have at least one purpose-relevant target dimension rated CHALLENGER_BETTER with sufficient confidence.
A challenger cannot be accepted with any unresolved critical regression.
Tradeoffs are retained explicitly; several small gains do not automatically override one serious regression.
Consistent pairwise preference supports but does not replace dimension evidence.
Tie or insufficient evidence yields RETAIN_ORIGINAL by default.
Human review is preferred over false certainty when evidence is materially contradictory or incomplete.
